option_relations.rationale: Multiple hereditary infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma syndrome (MHIBCC) is a distinct entity from Nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome (Gorlin syndrome).
Infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma is a specific histological subtype of basal cell carcinoma, not a syndrome, and is not equivalent to Nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome (Gorlin syndrome).
Basal cell nevus syndrome is synonymous with Gorlin syndrome, which is equivalent to the provided leaf 'Nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome (Gorlin syndrome)'.
Gorlin Syndrome (Basal Cell Nevus Syndrome) is synonymous with Nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome (Gorlin syndrome).
